label: IntelliJ index
description: Code navigation and refactoring through the IDE Index MCP Server plugin of a running JetBrains IDE.

errors.reply: The IDE could not run {tool} because a language server plugin inside the IDE failed to start. Use the other intellij-index tools, and the build or tests for errors.
The IDE has {tool} switched off. Use the other code tools or the shell instead.
The IDE does not have this working copy open, so {tool} cannot answer for it. Use the other tools and the shell instead; the Human can open it in the IDE.

help: Open a JetBrains IDE with the IDE Index MCP Server plugin, switch on the tools named here in its settings, or change the port.
instructions: IMPORTANT: When applicable, prefer using intellij-index MCP tools for code navigation and refactoring. Every call answers for your own working copy, and paths are relative to it.

roleNotes.peer: Run `ide_diagnostics` on the files you changed, then the project's checks, before you hand back.
roleNotes.reviewer: Run `ide_diagnostics` on the files the change touched.
